conditions: retain copyright notice, conditions, and disclaimer in source redistribution
reproduce copyright notice, conditions, and disclaimer in binary redistribution materials
do not use copyright-holder or contributor names for endorsement without permission
license.decision_basis: Exact pinned BSD-3-Clause license grants redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification. Project policy therefore approves this exact bounded source snapshot for model-training use subject to the license conditions; approval is not inferred from public availability.

capacity_rule: Count only the five selected substantive implementation files after all gates pass; docs, tests, examples, generated files, packaging metadata, vendored copies, and license text do not count as code capacity.

evaluation_boundary.future_reservation_rule: Any exact path/blob identity reserved by a later evaluation authority before final sealing is excluded and capacity is recomputed.

dedup.exact_identity: Git blob SHA-1 and raw SHA-256 at execution
dedup.family_rule: pallets/jinja is one independent upstream family; five files increase byte capacity but count as one family

required_gates: canonical upstream repository is not a fork or mirror
license bytes match pinned Git blob identity
every selected file byte size and Git blob identity match
Python AST parse and compile succeed
privacy-like email and private-IP scan passes
generated/vendored/build/minified path and marker checks pass
no exact or >=0.85 near duplicate against selected files or incumbent admitted code objects
no selected path/blob is evaluation-reserved at final live-registry check
